Dear Ritika,

— ✦ —

From 5th standard to now, you've seen every version of me. The annoying one, the yapping one, the overthinking one. And you're still here. Still replying. Still making fun of me. I appreciate that more than you know.

You're my one and only best female, and watching you grow into who you are now — I'm genuinely proud. Once again, happy Women's Day Ritu — the only woman I trust and know after my mom. 🌈
